extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides paged indexed browsing, scoped search and recently played/resume lists, controls HLS quality and MP4 buffering, and can persist downloaded subtitles for replay.
extension.news: 0.6.2 - Replace numbered UI pages with indexed A-Z/year browsing, restore native Kodi sorting, unify movie/TV search, and discover all provider TV catalogue pages automatically.
